req.title: List returns empty array when db empty
req.statement: The system shall return an empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist.
triggers: list returns empty array when db empty

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-033 requires GET /tasks/ to return an empty JSON array when no tasks exist. The key challenge is ensuring the database is truly empty before the request. We use an in-memory SQLite override via FastAPI's dependency injection to guarantee isolation. Three tests cover: (1) positive — empty DB yields [] with status 200; (2) negative — a client error (invalid query param type) yields 422, not 2xx; (3) boundary — DB with exactly one task yields a non-empty array (proving the empty-array path is distinct from the populated path, catching mutations that always return []). Each test overrides get_db with a fresh in-memory session so the pre-loaded fixture rows are irrelevant.

tests.name: test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array
actions: Override get_db dependency with a fresh in-memory SQLite session containing no rows
Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is exactly the JSON empty array []
trace: R-TASK-033: system shall return empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist
EP: empty-DB partition — zero rows is the representative member of the 'no tasks' equivalence class
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array():
    engine = create_engine(
        "sqlite:///:memory:",
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
    )
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    try:
        client = TestClient(app)
        r = client.get("/tasks/")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert body == []
        assert isinstance(body, list)
        assert len(body) == 0
        assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.pop(get_db, None)

test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_empty_array()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

def test_list_tasks_one_row_returns_nonempty_array():
    engine = create_engine(
        "sqlite:///:memory:",
        connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
    )
    models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
    TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

    def override_get_db():
        db = TestingSession()
        try:
            yield db
        finally:
            db.close()

    seed_db = TestingSession()
    task = models.Task(title="Boundary Task", description=None, completed=False)
    seed_db.add(task)
    seed_db.commit()
    seed_db.close()

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
    try:
        client = TestClient(app)
        r = client.get("/tasks/")
        assert r.status_code == 200
        body = r.json()
        assert isinstance(body, list)
        assert len(body) == 1
        assert body != []
        assert body[0]["title"] == "Boundary Task"
        assert body[0]["completed"] == False
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.pop(get_db, None)

test_list_tasks_one_row_returns_nonempty_array()
